label: DIFF14检查
js: (() => { const dlg = document.querySelector('[data-testid=print-dialog]') || document.querySelector('[role=dialog]') || document.body; const text = dlg.textContent || ''; const hasTestId = (id) => !!document.querySelector('[data-testid="' + id + '"]'); const want = { groupPrinter: '打印机', groupRange: '打印范围', groupSettings: '设置', fName: '名称', fPort: '位置', fPrinterProps: '打印机属性', fQty: '打印数量', fCopy: '单签拷贝', fStartRecord: '启始记录', fCurrentOnly: '只打印数据表中当前记录行的数据', fUpdateVars: '打印后更新变量数据', fBorder: '打印标签边框', fRotate180: '旋转180度输出', startLabel: '选取起始标签', autoTrack: '自动跟踪起始标签位置', advanced: '高级选项' }; const present = {}; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(want)) present[k] = text.includes(v); const ids = { preview: 'print-dialog-preview', testPrint: 'print-dialog-test-print', help: 'print-dialog-help', submit: 'print-dialog-submit', advancedBtn: 'print-dialog-advanced' }; const btnPresent = {}; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ids)) btnPresent[k] = hasTestId(v); const missing = [...Object.entries(present).filter(([, v]) => !v).map(([k]) => k), ...Object.entries(btnPresent).filter(([, v]) => !v).map(([k]) => 'btn:' + k)]; return JSON.stringify({ missingCount: missing.length, missing, present, btnPresent }) })()

label: 启用禁用态抽查
js: (() => { const border = document.querySelector('[data-testid="print-option-border"]'); const out = { borderExists: !!border }; if (border) { const inp = border.querySelector ? border.querySelector('input') : null; out.borderDisabled = inp ? !!inp.disabled : (border.disabled ?? null) } return JSON.stringify(out) })()
